The '''female shanjaru''' was the last [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of [[shanjaru]], a species that was driven nearly to extinction at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Drooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] possessed the beast and wished to obtain the last [[male shanjaru]] in order to serve them as part of his feast. [[Risha Drayen]] obtained the male shanjaru and wished to traded him to Drooga in exchange for a prototype engine. However, [[Momi Andrell]] and a group of animal rights activists working to save the shanjaru and repopulate the species stole the female from Drooga's [[Drooga's pleasure barge|pleasure barge]] and took genetic samples, sending them to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Risha's companion [[Voidhound]] had to retrieve the female and send her back to Drooga before their deal could be finalized.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The female shanjaru appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Smuggler class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
